Card Q&A.a: Since the security effect didn't activate, the card goes to the trash.
Card Q&A.q: This card performs a security check, flipping over an Option card with a security effect. What happens to the Option card if its effect didn't activate?

Effect: [When Digivolving] This Digimon gains ＜Security Attack +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card) for the turn.
[Your Turn] This Digimon doesn't activate [Security] skills on Option Cards it checks.
